text_en: Now the man knew his wife Eve, and she conceived and bore Cain, saying, “I have produced a man with the help of the Lord . ”
text_cn: 亚当认识了自己的妻子厄娃，厄娃怀了孕，生了加音说：“我赖上主获得了一个人。”

text_en: Next she bore his brother Abel. Now Abel was a keeper of sheep, and Cain a tiller of the ground.
text_cn: 以后她生了加音的弟弟亚伯尔；亚伯尔牧羊，加音耕田。

text_en: In the course of time Cain brought to the Lord an offering of the fruit of the ground,
text_cn: 有一天，加音把田地的出产作祭品献给天主；

text_en: and Abel for his part brought of the firstlings of his flock, their fat portions. And the Lord had regard for Abel and his offering,
text_cn: 同时亚伯尔献上自己羊群中最肥美而又是首生的羊；上主惠顾了亚伯尔和他的祭品，

text_en: but for Cain and his offering he had no regard. So Cain was very angry, and his countenance fell.
text_cn: 却没有惠顾加音和他的祭品；因此加音大怒，垂头丧气。

text_en: The Lord said to Cain, “Why are you angry, and why has your countenance fallen?
text_cn: 上主对加音说：“你为什么发怒？为什么垂头丧气？”

text_en: If you do well, will you not be accepted? And if you do not do well, sin is lurking at the door; its desire is for you, but you must master it. ”
text_cn: 你若做得好，岂不也可仰起头来？你若做得不好，罪恶就伏在你门前，企图对付你，但你应制服它。”

text_en: Cain said to his brother Abel, “Let us go out to the field. ” And when they were in the field, Cain rose up against his brother Abel, and killed him.
text_cn: 事后加音对他弟弟亚伯尔说：“我们到田间去！”当他们在田间的时候，加音就袭击了弟弟亚伯尔，将他杀死。

text_en: Then the Lord said to Cain, “Where is your brother Abel? ” He said, “I do not know; am I my brother’s keeper? ”
text_cn: 上主对加音说：“你弟弟亚伯尔在哪里？”他答说：“我不知道，难道我是看守我弟弟的人？”

text_en: And the Lord said, “What have you done? Listen; your brother’s blood is crying out to me from the ground!
text_cn: 上主说：“你作了什么事？听！你弟弟的血由地上向我喊冤。

text_en: And now you are cursed from the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.
text_cn: 你现在是地上所咒骂的人，地张开口由你手中接收了你弟弟的血，

text_en: When you till the ground, it will no longer yield to you its strength; you will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth. ”
text_cn: 从此你即使耕种，地也不会给你出产；你在地上要成个流离失所的人。”

text_en: Cain said to the Lord , “My punishment is greater than I can bear!
text_cn: 加音对上主说：“我的罪罚太重，无法承担。

text_en: Today you have driven me away from the soil, and I shall be hidden from your face; I shall be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth, and anyone who meets me may kill me. ”
text_cn: 看你今天将我由这地面上驱逐，我该躲避你的面，在地上成了个流离失所的人；那么凡遇见我的，必要杀我。”

text_en: Then the Lord said to him, “Not so! Whoever kills Cain will suffer a sevenfold vengeance. ” And the Lord put a mark on Cain, so that no one who came upon him would kill him.
text_cn: 上主对他说：“决不这样，凡杀加音的人，一定要受七倍的罚。”上主遂给加音一个记号，以免遇见他的人击杀他。

text_en: Then Cain went away from the presence of the Lord , and settled in the land of Nod, east of Eden.
text_cn: 加音就离开上主的面，住在伊甸东方的诺得地方。

text_en: Cain knew his wife, and she conceived and bore Enoch; and he built a city, and named it Enoch after his son Enoch.
text_cn: 加音认识了自己的妻子，她怀了孕，生了哈诺客。加音建筑了一座城，即以他儿子的名字，给这城起名叫“哈诺客”。

text_en: To Enoch was born Irad; and Irad was the father of Mehujael, and Mehujael the father of Methushael, and Methushael the father of Lamech.
text_cn: 哈诺客生了依辣得；依辣得生了默胡雅耳；默胡雅耳生了默突沙耳；默突沙耳生了拉默客。

text_en: Lamech took two wives; the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.
text_cn: 拉默客娶了两个妻子：一个名叫阿达，一个名叫漆拉。

text_en: Adah bore Jabal; he was the ancestor of those who live in tents and have livestock.
text_cn: 阿达生了雅巴耳，他是住在帐幕内畜牧者的始祖。

text_en: His brother’s name was Jubal; he was the ancestor of all those who play the lyre and pipe.
text_cn: 他的弟弟名叫犹巴耳，他是所有弹琴吹箫者的始祖。

text_en: Zillah bore Tubal-cain, who made all kinds of bronze and iron tools. The sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah.
text_cn: 同时漆拉也生了突巴耳加音，他是制造各种铜铁器具的匠人。突巴耳加音有个姊妹名叫纳阿玛。

text_en: Lamech said to his wives: “Adah and Zillah, hear my voice; you wives of Lamech, listen to what I say: I have killed a man for wounding me, a young man for striking me.
text_cn: 拉默客对自己的妻子说：“阿达和漆拉倾听我的声音，拉默客的妻子，静聆我的言语：因我受伤，杀了一成年；因我受损，杀了一青年；

text_en: If Cain is avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy-sevenfold. ”
text_cn: 杀加音的受罚是七倍，杀拉默客的是七十七倍。”

text_en: Adam knew his wife again, and she bore a son and named him Seth, for she said, “God has appointed for me another child instead of Abel, because Cain killed him. ”
text_cn: 亚当又认识了自己的妻子，她生了个儿子，给他起名叫舍特说：“天主又赐给了我一个儿子，代替加音杀了的亚伯尔。”

text_en: To Seth also a son was born, and he named him Enosh. At that time people began to invoke the name of the Lord .
text_cn: 舍特也生了一个儿子，给他起名叫厄诺士。那时人才开始呼求上主的名。
